description: Planning template for adding a membrane-transporter family to the existing blind/OOD/smoke governance pattern. Aquaporin_1 is the first lower-risk entry point, and GLUT1_4PYP is the higher-upside expanded-OOD path.

sets.title: Core Blind Set
sets.purpose: Primary membrane-family blind performance set for the first AQP1 family extension.

sets.title: Expanded OOD Set
sets.purpose: Secondary membrane-family OOD set for GLUT1 under the same governance rules used elsewhere in the package.

sets.title: Operational Smoke Set
sets.purpose: Optional fast reproducibility support set for the first membrane-family extension.

implementation_notes: Do not promote this template to a runnable spec until transporter-family ligand packets, target metadata TODO values, and scaffold donor placeholders are replaced or explicitly frozen.
The referenced profile JSONs are dry-run structural templates only; they intentionally remain non-claim scaffolds even though they preserve the standard runnable file shape.
Reuse the current blind/OOD/smoke governance pattern instead of inventing family-specific acceptance rules.
Freeze whether EGFR_KINASE remains the fit donor or a membrane-family donor pool replaces it before first runnable execution.
